title: Metallic collective-support bond
statement: Metallic bonding is stable collective recurrence of a connected atomic network supported by electron-labelled paths delocalized across multiple cells of the complete finite network.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered metallic carrier, electron, extent, joining, recurrence, identity, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite connected atomic network whose electron-labelled accessible support extends across multiple atomic cells and whose collective recurrence stabilizes the whole carrier.

choices.name: isolated-atom-pair
choices.reason: Metallic support is collective rather than one fixed pair.

choices.name: connected-atomic-network
choices.reason: All participating atomic cells belong to one connected support.

choices.name: localized-pair-only
choices.reason: A fixed pair cannot mediate the complete network.

choices.name: delocalized-electron-support
choices.reason: Electron-labelled support extends over multiple cells.

choices.name: unrecorded-infinite-lattice
choices.reason: A completed infinite lattice is not generated.

choices.name: finite-whole-network-extent
choices.reason: The complete generated network is retained at its boundary.

choices.name: independent-local-bonds-only
choices.reason: Independent local pairs omit collective redistribution.

choices.name: collective-shared-support
choices.reason: One extended support joins the network compositionally.

choices.name: transient-conduction-only
choices.reason: Transport alone does not establish stable bonding.

choices.name: stable-collective-recurrence
choices.reason: The connected whole returns as a material carrier.

choices.name: anonymous-metal-label
choices.reason: A metal label cannot create the law.

choices.name: atomic-and-network-identities
choices.reason: Constituents and collective identity remain held.

choices.name: metallic-label-only
choices.reason: A label cannot reproduce topology and support.

choices.name: network-electron-recurrence-trace
choices.reason: Adjacency, support extent and recurrence remain auditable.

choices.name: free-electron-sea-premise
choices.reason: An imported metaphor cannot select the structure.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Connected delocalized support supplies the class.

induction_base: Three connected atomic cells with one electron-labelled path extending across the network supply the first non-pairwise collective support.
induction_step: Appending one adjacent cell extends the finite delocalized support and preserves connectedness, every atomic identity and stable collective recurrence.
exclusions: no IUPAC bond definition, orbital equation, electronegativity scale, measured value or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application result or opaque predictor
no universal bond-length/strength formula inferred from a categorical correspondence
official target content opens only through post-seal custody
Every finite connected atomic network whose electron-labelled accessible support extends across multiple atomic cells and whose collective recurrence stabilizes the whole carrier.
operational_witnesses: support extends beyond one fixed pair
falsification_condition: The claim fails if IUPAC lacks nonlocalized electrons, extended whole-lattice support or explicit metal correspondence, or if a changed row is accepted.
